messages:
maya: Heads-up, opening a thread for a docs PR to migrate console observability presets/examples to metrics_v2. Quick summary: converter removed null trace_key, span_sampling changed from bool->object, and a playground link is 404.
trent: drop the PR link when ready. I can handle redirects.
maya: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5177 - CI failed on examples job: TypeError in renderer: expected str for trace_key but got None.
zoe: I've seen this. Converter strips nulls; we should emit an explicit empty string for trace_key. Also include migration note about span_sampling shape.
docs-bot: Suggested temp replacement for dead link: https://console.redwood.ai/playground. Filed infra ticket REDW-1333.
maya: example snippet in PR that failed:
```yaml
presets:
  - name: kv-latency-heatmap
    metrics_schema: 'v1'
    tracehook:
      trace_key: null
      span_sampling: true
    blocks:
      - type: heatmap
        metric: latency_p95
```
zoe: proposed v2 conversion:
```yaml
presets:
  - name: kv-latency-heatmap
    metrics_schema: 'v2'
    tracehook:
      trace_key: ""
      span_sampling:
        strategy: probabilistic
        rate: 0.01
    blocks:
      - type: heatmap
        metric: latency.p95
        cost_mode: normalized
```
trent: also watch SDK snippets: cost_per_token -> unit_cost.tokens and `kv_cache: enabled` -> `kv_prefix` update in rust/python snippets. I'll sweep those in a follow-up.
ci-bot: CI re-run queued by @maya.
maya: added checklist to PR: manual render, run example smoke tests, docs-owners review.
zoe: reviewed and left one nit on wording in the migration guide.
trent: fixed wording, pushed.
ci-bot: CI passed.
maya: merged. Post-merge: opening follow-ups REDW-1334 (SDK snippet sweep) and REDW-1333 (infra redirect). Thanks all :tada:
